table3data.name: Galvanic Spear
table3data.desc: 20 consective thunderous strikes. Piercing enemies and chain lighting for every strike

table3data.name: Scorch Kartana
table3data.desc: Control the weight of the arrows and how far they carry. Can shoot 5 arrows at a time, making them heavy or light and able to control the speed in which the arrows fly

table3data.name: Gravity Long Bow
table3data.desc: Control the weight of the arrows and how far they carry. Can shoot 5 arrows at a time, making them heavy or light and able to control the speed in which the arrows fly

table3data.name: Ripple Rapier
table3data.desc: Blade is made of high pressure water, making you able to control the length and being able to cut around any tight corners. A flexible blade of water that can cut enemies, even through cracks of walls

table3data.name: Blood Sickles
table3data.desc: Able to teleport through blood portals, making movement unpredicable. Able to throw them and grapple opponents along with doing long ranged slices through the air
